name: Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd., a trading company, sells paper, paperboard, wastepaper, and other paper-related materials worldwide. It operates through Northeast Asia, Europe/Americas, the Asia Pacific, and Real Estate Leasing segments.
